channel.title: FlowClip
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.description:
• Fixes:
    • Fixed Raycast Beta Pick Color results in hexadecimal format not being saved to FlowClip history.
    • Kept unrelated auto-generated, transient, and concealed clipboard data excluded from history.

• Improvements:
    • Added a dedicated Accessibility permission window that updates in real time and confirms when permission is granted.
    • Added live Accessibility permission status and a direct System Settings button to General settings.
  • Fixes:
    • Prevented Queue Clipboard monitoring and paste operations from starting without Accessibility permission.
    • Fixed “Popup at: Menu icon” leaving a gap below the menu bar.

• Improvements:
    • Added a Queue Clipboard popup position setting in Appearance preferences.
    • Queue Clipboard now opens from the menu bar icon by default.

• Improvements:
    • Added image thumbnails in clipboard and queue lists so image clips are easier to recognize.
    • Reduced memory use for large clipboard items by storing large payloads outside the database and loading image data only when needed.
    • Downsampled image thumbnails and previews before rendering to avoid memory spikes with large images.
  • Fixes:
    • Cleaned up stored large-content files when history, queue, or pinned items are removed.
    • Removed orphaned clipboard content files on load and migrated existing large inline contents to external storage.

• Improvements:
    • Improved image clipboard search by storing OCR text as searchable metadata instead of using it as the visible item title.
    • Upgraded image text recognition to use accurate recognition, language correction, and automatic language detection.
  • Fixes:
    • Prevented OCR text from appearing as the title of copied images.
    • Migrated existing image OCR titles into search-only metadata so older image clips remain searchable without showing OCR text in the list.

• Improvements:
    • Reworked Queue paste separator settings so each preset stores its own separator type: None, Space, Newline, Comma, or Custom.
    • Updated the General settings flow to select a preset first, then choose its separator type, while keeping custom input available only when needed.

• Fixes:
    • Fixed a Moom compatibility issue that could show its hover palette over the FlowClip menu popup and the Queue Clipboard window by suppressing hidden traffic-light hover targets. Thanks to Richard Simmonds for the report.

• Improvements:
    • Queue Clipboard separator button now previews the actual delimiter instead of only showing preset numbers like S1 or S2.
    • Separator previews stay compact while still showing newline and tab delimiters with visible symbols.

• Improvements:
    • Added drag-and-drop reordering for pinned items in the Pins settings tab.
    • Keeps the pin order in Settings in sync with the pinned order shown in the main popup.

• New Features:
    • Added pinned item drag-and-drop so you can reorder pinned items directly in the clipboard history.
  • Fixes:
    • Fixed clipboard panel sizing and layout regressions introduced while adding pinned item drag-and-drop.
    • Clearing a search now restores the panel to the user’s saved window size more reliably, including cases with image or file previews.

• Queue Clipboard title text area is now draggable for moving the window.
  • Added Queue paste separator presets (up to 9) with cycling support.
  • Added separator preset indicator in Queue controls (next to FIFO/LIFO).
  • Added preset save/delete management in General settings.
  • Added a shortcut setting to cycle separator presets.
  • When all presets are empty, Queue controls now show S0 (no selected preset).
  • Updated funding source to GitHub Sponsors.

• Show image previews in clipboard history when copying image files (png/jpg/jpeg/heic) from Finder.
  • Keep non-image file copy behavior unchanged.
  • Internal stability update around file URL handling for image items.

• Hotfix:
    • Fixed Queue Clipboard item drag reordering so item order updates reliably while dragging.
    • Thanks to Richard Simmonds for reporting this issue.

• Improvements:
    • Improved click behavior in Queue Clipboard controls so interactions feel more forgiving.
  • Bug Fixes:
    • Fixed a panel focus issue where clicking controls or items could require an extra click when the panel was not focused.
    • Fixed Queue Clipboard control interaction so segmented control areas are easier to click without changing the visual design.

• New Features:
    • Queue Auto-Split: Copied multi-line text can now be automatically split into separate queue items, including single newline-separated lines.
    • Queue Controls: Added a dedicated Auto-Split toggle button in Queue Clipboard controls and shortcut options for Auto-Split and LIFO/FIFO order toggling.
  • Improvements:
    • Audio Feedback: Queue toggles and clear action now play consistent Morse sound feedback.
  • Bug Fixes:
    • Paste Without Formatting: Queue paste now correctly respects the plain-text paste preference.
    • General Settings Layout: Fixed clipping/overflow issues in behavior and custom separator controls in localized UI.

• New Features:
    • Queue Reordering: You can now drag and drop items in the Queue Clipboard to reorder them before pasting.

• New Features:
    • Queue Clipboard Redesign: A cleaner, modern look with a floating bottom bar for controls and a separate floating clear button.
    • LIFO/FIFO Toggle: You can now switch between Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) and First-In-First-Out (FIFO) paste order in the Queue Clipboard.
  • Improvements:
    • Focus Handling: When using Cmd+C or Cmd+V within the Queue Clipboard, FlowClip now temporarily yields focus to the background app to ensure the action is performed on the correct target.

• Enhancements:
    • Queue Clipboard Redesign: The Queue Clipboard window has been redesigned for a better user experience.
    • Custom Separator: Added options to customize the separator when pasting multiple items.
  • Bug Fixes:
    • Window Height: Fixed unexpected window shrinking; it now respects your preferred size.
    • Settings Window: Fixed app quitting when closing Settings; now stays in the menu bar.
• Fixed black corners on App Icon by correcting transparency rendering.
